meanings.en: a poisonous snake with large fangs
meanings.exampleEn: A viper slithered across the rocky path.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayalık patikada bir engerek süzülerek geçti.

meanings.en: a treacherous or malicious person
meanings.exampleEn: He turned out to be a viper who betrayed his closest friends.
meanings.exampleTr: En yakın dostlarına ihanet eden bir kalleş çıktı.

meanings.en: a school where teaching and learning take place online rather than in person
meanings.exampleEn: During the pandemic, many children attended a virtual school from home.
meanings.exampleTr: Pandemi sırasında birçok çocuk evden sanal okula devam etti.

meanings.en: a person with original ideas about what the future could be like
meanings.exampleEn: Steve Jobs is often described as a visionary in technology.
meanings.exampleTr: Steve Jobs teknoloji alanında sık sık bir vizyoner olarak tanımlanır.

meanings.en: showing clear and original ideas about the future
meanings.exampleEn: Her visionary leadership transformed the company.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun vizyoner liderliği şirketi dönüştürdü.

meanings.en: a distant view seen through a long, narrow opening
meanings.exampleEn: From the hilltop we enjoyed a stunning vista of the valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Tepenin zirvesinden vadinin muhteşem manzarasının keyfini çıkardık.

meanings.en: a range of possibilities that may develop in the future
meanings.exampleEn: The new technology opens up exciting vistas for research.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni teknoloji araştırma için heyecan verici ufuklar açıyor.

meanings.en: a number of bullets or arrows fired at the same time
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers fired a volley of shots into the air.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler havaya bir yaylım ateş açtı.

meanings.en: a hit or kick of the ball before it touches the ground
meanings.exampleEn: She won the point with a powerful volley at the net.
meanings.exampleTr: Filenin önünde güçlü bir voleyle sayıyı kazandı.

meanings.en: eating or wanting large amounts of food
meanings.exampleEn: Teenagers often have voracious appetites.
meanings.exampleTr: Gençlerin çoğu zaman doymak bilmez iştahları vardır.

meanings.en: very eager for something, especially a lot of it
meanings.exampleEn: She is a voracious reader who finishes a book every day.
meanings.exampleTr: Her gün bir kitap bitiren, kitaba doymayan bir okurdur.

meanings.tr: aleyhinde oy vermek, karşı oy vermek
meanings.en: to formally express opposition to something in a vote
meanings.exampleEn: Most members voted against the proposed budget cuts.
meanings.exampleTr: Üyelerin çoğu önerilen bütçe kesintilerine karşı oy verdi.

meanings.en: able to be easily hurt, harmed, or attacked
meanings.exampleEn: Elderly people are especially vulnerable to the virus.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı insanlar virüse karşı özellikle savunmasızdır.

meanings.en: to enter a place on foot, often without an appointment
meanings.exampleEn: You can just walk in without booking an appointment.
meanings.exampleTr: Randevu almadan öylece içeri girebilirsiniz.

meanings.en: the state of being pale, especially from illness or tiredness
meanings.exampleEn: The wanness of her face showed how ill she had been.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzünün solgunluğu ne kadar hasta olduğunu gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: aggressive and ready or eager to fight a war
meanings.exampleEn: The tribe had a fierce and warlike reputation.
meanings.exampleTr: Kabile sert ve savaşçı bir üne sahipti.

meanings.en: a man who is believed to have magic powers; a male witch
meanings.exampleEn: In the story, a powerful warlock cast a spell on the village.
meanings.exampleTr: Hikayede güçlü bir büyücü köye bir büyü yaptı.

meanings.en: a complete failure or disappointment
meanings.exampleEn: The outdoor concert was a total washout because of the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Açık hava konseri yağmur yüzünden tam bir fiyaskoydu.

meanings.en: the amount of something that is wasted or lost
meanings.exampleEn: Better planning could reduce food wastage in restaurants.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha iyi planlama restoranlarda yiyecek israfını azaltabilir.

meanings.en: a container for waste paper and small pieces of rubbish
meanings.exampleEn: She crumpled the letter and tossed it into the wastebasket.
meanings.exampleTr: Mektubu buruşturup çöp sepetine attı.

meanings.en: a person who wastes money, time, or opportunities
meanings.exampleEn: His father called him a wastrel who never held a steady job.
meanings.exampleTr: Babası ona, hiç düzenli bir işte çalışmayan bir avare derdi.

meanings.en: used to warn someone to be careful about a danger
meanings.exampleEn: Watch out! There's a car coming.
meanings.exampleTr: Dikkat et! Bir araba geliyor.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to guard a building, especially at night
meanings.exampleEn: The night watchman checked every door before locking up.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece bekçisi kapatmadan önce her kapıyı kontrol etti.

meanings.en: a person who travels from place to place, especially on foot
meanings.exampleEn: The old inn once welcomed weary wayfarers on the mountain road.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski han bir zamanlar dağ yolundaki yorgun yolcuları ağırlardı.

meanings.tr: pusuya yatıp yolunu kesmek, yolda çevirmek
meanings.en: to stop someone as they are going somewhere, especially to attack or talk to them
meanings.exampleEn: Reporters waylaid the minister as he left the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Muhabirler bakanı binadan çıkarken yolda çevirdiler.

meanings.en: used by a speaker to refer to himself/herself and one or more other people
meanings.exampleEn: We are going to the cinema tonight.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu gece sinemaya gidiyoruz.

meanings.en: a person who is physically weak or lacks strength of character
meanings.exampleEn: He was teased as a weakling because he couldn't lift the box.
meanings.exampleTr: Kutuyu kaldıramadığı için güçsüz diye alay edildi.

meanings.en: to gradually stop feeding a baby or young animal with its mother's milk
meanings.exampleEn: Most mothers wean their babies at around six months.
meanings.exampleTr: Çoğu anne bebeğini altı ay civarında sütten keser.

meanings.en: to make someone gradually stop depending on something
meanings.exampleEn: The program aims to wean addicts off drugs.
meanings.exampleTr: Program bağımlıları uyuşturucudan yavaş yavaş vazgeçirmeyi amaçlıyor.

meanings.en: having no weapon or weapons
meanings.exampleEn: The weaponless soldiers were forced to surrender.
meanings.exampleTr: Silahsız askerler teslim olmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: the feeling of being very tired
meanings.exampleEn: A deep weariness came over her after the long journey.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yolculuktan sonra derin bir yorgunluk çöktü üzerine.

meanings.en: available on or operated through the internet
meanings.exampleEn: The company uses a web-based system to manage orders.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket siparişleri yönetmek için web tabanlı bir sistem kullanıyor.

meanings.en: thin and weak-looking
meanings.exampleEn: He was a weedy boy who avoided all sports.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün sporlardan kaçınan sıska bir çocuktu.

meanings.en: full of weeds
meanings.exampleEn: The garden had become weedy after months of neglect.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçe aylarca ihmal edildikten sonra yabani otlarla dolmuştu.

meanings.en: the state of having no weight, especially in space
meanings.exampleEn: Astronauts must train to cope with weightlessness.
meanings.exampleTr: Astronotlar ağırlıksızlıkla başa çıkmak için eğitim almalıdır.

meanings.en: the quality of being strange or unusual
meanings.exampleEn: There was a certain weirdness about the empty town.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş kasabada belli bir tuhaflık vardı.

meanings.en: having a lot of knowledge or skill in a particular subject
meanings.exampleEn: She is well-versed in international law.
meanings.exampleTr: Uluslararası hukuk konusunda çok bilgilidir.

meanings.en: the state of being healthy in body and mind
meanings.exampleEn: The company offers a wellness program for its employees.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket çalışanları için bir sağlık ve esenlik programı sunuyor.

meanings.en: the state of being wet or covered with liquid
meanings.exampleEn: She could feel the wetness of the grass under her feet.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayaklarının altında çimenlerin ıslaklığını hissedebiliyordu.

meanings.en: used to ask for information about something
meanings.exampleEn: What time is it?
meanings.exampleTr: Saat kaç?

meanings.en: the thing or things that
meanings.exampleEn: Tell me what you want.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne istediğini söyle bana.

meanings.en: anything or everything that; no matter what
meanings.exampleEn: You can order whatever you like from the menu.
meanings.exampleTr: Menüden ne istersen sipariş edebilirsin.

meanings.en: to breathe with difficulty, making a whistling sound
meanings.exampleEn: He began to wheeze as he climbed the stairs.
meanings.exampleTr: Merdivenleri çıkarken hırıltıyla nefes almaya başladı.

meanings.en: a whistling sound made when breathing with difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor heard a faint wheeze in his chest.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor göğsünden gelen hafif bir hırıltı duydu.

meanings.en: a young dog or a young animal of certain wild species
meanings.exampleEn: The wolf carried her whelp gently in her mouth.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurt yavrusunu ağzında nazikçe taşıdı.

meanings.en: used to compare or contrast two facts
meanings.exampleEn: Some people prefer tea, whereas others prefer coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı insanlar çayı tercih eder, oysa diğerleri kahveyi tercih eder.

meanings.en: in or to any place or every place
meanings.exampleEn: You can sit wherever you like.
meanings.exampleTr: Nereye istersen oturabilirsin.

meanings.en: to increase someone's desire for or interest in something
meanings.exampleEn: The free sample whetted my appetite for more.
meanings.exampleTr: Ücretsiz numune daha fazlası için iştahımı kabarttı.

meanings.en: to sharpen the blade of a knife or tool
meanings.exampleEn: He whetted the knife on a stone.
meanings.exampleTr: Bıçağı bir taşta biledi.

meanings.en: used to introduce a choice between two possibilities
meanings.exampleEn: I don't know whether to accept the offer or not.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklifi kabul edip etmeyeceğimi bilmiyorum.

meanings.en: used to ask about a choice between a limited number of things
meanings.exampleEn: Which of these books is yours?
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kitaplardan hangisi senin?

meanings.en: used to give more information about a thing already mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: The house, which was built in 1900, is still standing.
meanings.exampleTr: 1900'de yapılan ev hâlâ ayakta.

meanings.en: any one or any group from a limited number
meanings.exampleEn: Choose whichever colour you prefer.
meanings.exampleTr: Hangi rengi tercih edersen onu seç.

meanings.en: during the time that something is happening
meanings.exampleEn: She listened to music while she was cooking.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek pişirirken müzik dinledi.

meanings.en: used to contrast two things
meanings.exampleEn: While I understand your point, I don't agree.
meanings.exampleTr: Görüşünü anlasam da katılmıyorum.

meanings.en: unusual and playful in an amusing way; behaving in an unpredictable way
meanings.exampleEn: The book is full of whimsical drawings of talking animals.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap konuşan hayvanların tuhaf ve eğlenceli çizimleriyle dolu.

meanings.en: a column of air that spins round very fast
meanings.exampleEn: A sudden whirlwind lifted the dust into the air.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani bir hortum tozu havaya kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a situation or series of events full of fast, chaotic activity
meanings.exampleEn: Their romance was a whirlwind of parties and travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşkları partiler ve seyahatlerle dolu baş döndürücü bir maceraydı.
